findings: Current manifests have blocked one-root candidates, no independent stream minimum and no live baseline parity.
Required controls missing from the paper matrix include task-conditioned ridge, J-masked/trace-only, locality and updater factors.
Assignment-change-up is invalid as a primary endpoint; use future quality/utility and preserve change rate as an unsigned diagnostic.
A topology label or renamed seed is not an independent structural root.
RARE can be directional-positive only when typed evidence is incrementally informative beyond a strong same-information control.
Trace-explained, constant-J, stale, sparse and high-cost regimes require tie/loss or two-sided directions.
H1 prediction, H2 future utility, H3 service and H4 attribution must not be merged.
Forgetting and recovery are distinct endpoints; coverage and UNKNOWN must accompany false attribution.
Strong contextual/task-ridge and matched-composition comparisons are required before method superiority can be claimed.
Meta-Team L2-public remains NO-GO until a faithful same-protocol adapter exists.
Latency, state, forgetting and recovery require a frozen implementation card; protocol prose alone cannot identify them.
Current data are diagnostic only and supply no numeric forecast.
